name: lateral bend on floor by kneeling
description: A kneeling side bend where you reach along the floor to stretch the side of the waist.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
